J1.source_weighting: normalize each source with its own denominator then average 1/2 each
J1.uncertainty: deterministic corpus quantities; unsupported-credit bounds are not statistical confidence intervals
J1.denominator: N, including space and escaped units
J1.event_and_modifier_repeat_escape_policy: Shift priced per shifted action; repeated identical actions have zero pair penalty; escapes break pairs
J1.coverage: A/D physical SF movement complete; credit bounds sum known credit plus 0..1 unknown mass; missing/zero event denominator rejected

key_effort.source_weighting: normalize each source with its own denominator then average 1/2 each

key_effort.definition: sum action count times frozen key effort
key_effort.event_and_modifier_repeat_escape_policy: includes repeated presses; excludes modifier presses here
key_effort.coverage: A/D physical SF movement complete; credit bounds sum known credit plus 0..1 unknown mass; missing/zero event denominator rejected

pair_effort.event_and_modifier_repeat_escape_policy: same action free; same key differing layers penalized; spaces zero

pair_effort.coverage: A/D physical SF movement complete; credit bounds sum known credit plus 0..1 unknown mass; missing/zero event denominator rejected
